title: Surreal Cliffside Vision
description: A lone hiker with a red backpack stands on a mossy cliff edge overlooking a vast purple lavender field under a dark sky with a red sun. Above, a glowing sphere contains four overlapping colorful female faces in purple, green, pink, and yellow, while below a mechanical orange circle with a robot figure connects via white lines.
prompt: A lone hiker wearing a red backpack stands on the edge of a moss-covered rocky cliff, looking out over an endless field of purple lavender under a black sky with a glowing red sun on the horizon. In the upper right, a large transparent glowing sphere contains four overlapping stylized female faces in purple, green, pink, and yellow tones. In the lower right, a mechanical target-like circle in teal and orange contains a small white robot figure, with white geometric lines connecting the elements, in a surreal symbolic style.
